reason: Adds four haos_only E2E tests (tests/src/e2e/haos_only/test_supervisor_log_window.py: hours_back page reads of the host journal, oldest-first and newest-first, and of the multicast journal to its end, through Supervisor directly or Core's hassio proxy) that run on every HAOS lane and skip at collection on the four non-HAOS lanes, and two inaddon_only tests (tests/src/e2e/workflows/system/test_supervisor_inaddon.py, TestGetLogsHoursBackReal: a 1-hour window of Supervisor's and the dev app's logs) that run on the inaddon lanes and skip at collection everywhere else.
